subject: church order
prompt: Complete 1 Timothy 3:15: “...which is the church of the living God, the ______ of the truth.”
verseText: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

subject: money
prompt: Complete 1 Timothy 6:10: “For the ______ is the root of all evil.”
verseText: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

verseText: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

subject: bishop qualifications
prompt: Both 1 Timothy 3:3 and Titus 1:7 list the same three disqualifiers for a bishop in identical wording. Which is that exact triple?
options: Not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre
Not greedy of filthy lucre, not a brawler, not covetous
Not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine
verseText: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verseTextB: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

subject: faithful sayings
prompt: The phrase “This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation” appears in 1 Timothy 1:15 concerning Christ saving sinners. Where else does Paul use the exact heading “This is a faithful saying” in these three books about maintaining good works?
verseText: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verseTextB: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

subject: the deposit
prompt: 1 Timothy 6:20 says “O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust.” Which verse in 2 Timothy repeats the same charge using the phrase “that good thing which was committed unto thee keep”?
verseText: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verseTextB: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
